frozen_reference_scope: actual stage0 weights/inputs; repeat the same immutable evaluation at each stage

definitions.final_average: equal weight per registered domain; no reweighting by video count
definitions.forgetting: max(0, best learned-domain score before final stage minus final score)
definitions.signed_forgetting: best learned-domain score before final minus final, may be negative
definitions.backward_transfer: final minus score immediately after that domain was learned; exclude final new domain
definitions.forward_transfer: score before learning each target domain minus its actual stage0 score

training_protocol.evaluation: all saved stages, isolated frozen weights after training; no evaluation feedback

actual_training_state_audit.scope: actual model/optimizer/replay state verification; not final MOT conclusions

completion_scope: complete seed17 forward first-wave six controls, development only; broader goal remains active
